app_fee.value: International applicants pay a $95 non-refundable application fee; the domestic fee is $75.

fee_waiver.value: The application fee is waived only for current Mines students, alumni and staff, plus GEM and McNair applicants; the Admissions Office does not waive other fees.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee is waived for current Mines students, alumni and staff

also.quote: Unfortunately, The Admissions Office does not waive applications fees.

gre_general.value: The graduate school says the GRE is required for some programs, so each program record gives its own rule.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is required for some programs.

toefl_min.value: Tests taken after January 20, 2026 need a total of 4 on Mines' table; older tests need 79.

ielts_min.value: The IELTS Academic minimum is an overall band of 6.5, with 6.0 in each section.

english_waiver.value: The degree waiver covers only completed degrees in the university's approved countries; India is not on that list, so Indian applicants need a listed English test.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who are not US citizens or permanent residents must submit English Proficiency scores as part of the application process

also.quote: Completion of a university degree program (or a minimum 18 credit hours) in a university-approved country (see chart below)
There are no other acceptable ways to prove english proficiency the ones listed.

notes: Thesis and PhD fall deadline for international applicants is March 1 (university deadlines page). Program pages list Spring 2027 dates only. Fee waiver page and FAQ disagree on waivers; Limited is kept with the conflict flagged. The approved-country chart in the admissions requirements page does not list India.
